verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. In both, the bottle is pushed into the bottom-right corner with only about 35px left below it, and the circle is cropped off the bottom-left. That makes the lower half feel crowded, and the bottle sits off the text's left edge with nothing to line it up to. B moves the whole text block about 30px lower, which squeezes the gaps between the body copy and the button and between the button and the bottle cap (about 20px). A spaces things a little more evenly, with a cleaner top margin and more room above the bottle.
